note: Samoa issues no national identity card yet. Its National Digital ID, a digital identity from birth administered by the Samoa Bureau of Statistics under the Samoa National Digital Identification Act 2025, opens for registration in a mass registration in 2027 (the Bureau's own pages, read 2026-11-03 from Common Crawl captures of 13 October 2026, the live site resetting the connection). Until then the entry stood on the SEAP digital ID overview, which said the system was still being rolled out.
